stem: In what way is the focus of the selections "Dive into a Sunken Museum" and "A Modern-Day Treasure Hunt" SIMILAR?
instruction: Use "Dive into a Sunken Museum" and "A Modern-Day Treasure Hunt" to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: Both selections show how an individual has used a talent to protect nature.

options.label: G
options.text: Both selections illustrate the way an individual has used art to create a puzzle.

options.label: H
options.text: Both selections detail the way an individual keeps the location of an object secret.

options.label: J
options.text: Both selections describe how an individual tries to attract visitors to a location.
